4. **It violates ethical guidelines** — I am not able to assist in creating, promoting, or selling content that exploits tragedy or spreads dangerous misinformation.

I will not navigate to any admin panel or take any action to facilitate this request.

If you have a legitimate product to add to a store, I'm happy to help with that instead.
